function.name: assign_work
function.description: Assign a new bounded Work outcome to the current Workspace or one of its direct child Workspaces. Runtime binds identity, revisions, authority, and predecessor provenance.

targetWorkspaceRef.description: Omit for the current Workspace; otherwise use an opaque ref returned by list_workspaces/read_workspace.

reason.description: Why this Work is being assigned now.

function.name: list_workspaces
function.description: List the current Workspace, active direct children, and in-flight formation summaries using scoped opaque refs.

function.name: read_workspace
function.description: Read one current/direct-child Workspace responsibility and open-work summary by scoped opaque ref.

function.name: accept_result
function.description: Accept one exact PASS result from an active direct-child Workspace using a scoped result ref. Runtime binds Work, revision and Verification identities.

function.name: propose_workspace
function.description: Propose a durable child workspace for an independent long-lived responsibility. A human governance decision (Approve/Reject/Modify) is required before the child is created.

name.description: Stable short name for the proposed child workspace.
